result.reason: The clause largely reaches the preferred position, but the absolute competitor prohibition applies only to IBM's assignment of “this Agreement,” not its assignment of rights under the Agreement. Thus, IBM could assign rights to a Customer competitor with Customer consent, contrary to the requirement that Vendor never assign to a competitor. The added prohibitions on suspension and re-pricing also exceed the stated requirement, which only calls for no termination right upon Customer's change of control. Otherwise, the Customer affiliate/successor carve-outs and consent standard are properly addressed. Drafting quality is severely undermined by the malformed rendering/formatting of the operative evaluation.
